quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Oh, my child... My child is locked up in there...

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: But my child is locked up in there. If I could just stage a rescue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The door has been opened...

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Eh, it must've been the two outland visitors from earlier... Ah, thank goodness!

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Right. I know what to do. Hmph, that lying liar who lies shall receive well-deserved punishment!

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Hmph, just keep playing that game. That sneaky swindler is going to taste utter defeat this time!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Oh-ho, a foreign guest!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: I guess arriving at the right time is better than being early. I just set this stall up today, and here you are.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: What fantastic luck, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You do have pretty good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, dear guest. I'm not talking about my luck, but yours!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our luck?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Indeed! Not everyone gets the chance to take the most ancient trial on the Hued-Jade Heights — the Painted Stone Challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: This is a trial left behind by the legendary hero of the Masters of the Night-Wind, um... Vallejodaken, designed to train the memory of our tribespeople and their ability to perceive color.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, was there ever such a hero from the Masters of the Night-Wind...?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Why, the tribe has a long and profound history. How could you outsiders hope to know all of it, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're not from the Masters of the Night-Wind, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: ...W—Well now! What does a legendary hero's trial have to do with which tribe I'm from? The six major tribes were established so long ago, surely it is high time the barriers between them went down... *ahem*.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Anyway, lucky travelers from afar — why don't you listen in on the rules of the Painted Stone Challenge? To be honest, the rewards I prepared are so generous it gives me conniptions!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It still sounds fishy, but there's no harm in listening... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: You'll hear it no matter what I say...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, a good adventurer should never pass up a chance for extra rewards!

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Then allow me, the heir of the hero Vallekan, to explain the rules to you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, did that name just change, or...

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Change? No, no, it was always the same name. *sigh* You foreigners just have trouble remembering the mighty names of our ancient heroes — but that's okay. Anyway, here's how the rules work...

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: When the challenge begins, the Iktomisaurus next to me will create differently-colored stones on the empty platform, which will disappear shortly...

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: What you must do is use the <color=#00E1FFFF>Hued Monetoo to grant color that corresponds</color> to the stones on each platform. As long as the colors match, you pass the stage.

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: So, this is actually a memory game. How about it? Pretty simple, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That doesn't sound very difficult...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Plus, there's two of us, so it's just remembering a couple of colors...

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Yes, yes. Oh-ho, isn't today your lucky day? But it's also an unlucky day — for my wallet.

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: So then, if you wish to play, it'll cost you 500 Mora to take part.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What, you still want Mora for this?

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Ah, but what you don't know, dear guest, is that the trials of our heroes have been passed down through the generations and have required much expenditure to maintain... Such tremendous efforts are beyond the ken of outsiders.

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Besides, compared with the final reward, 500 Mora is a drop in the bucket. Ah, it's more like a barrier to entry, testing a challenger's sincerity in wanting to experience the trial...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay okay, well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's gonna fork up the fee, {NICKNAME}, but you gotta win!

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Okay then, you two: Shall we get things started?

choices.text: Well, let's see what you call "lucky" around here, then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Teehee, that word always fills Paimon with excitement!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! How wonderful! How exciting! The Painted Stone Challenge welcomes its newest challenger! Let the games begin!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: What a shame, dear guests, you almost got it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, that can't be! Our answer was correct, Paimon's sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Ah, well, doesn't everyone who gets it wrong think so too? That's normal, absolutely normal. The final test's difficulty is different from the others, though...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: "This is the final test, sure, but it looks easy enough..."

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Ask yourself this, my little flying guest: Did you not think this way, even if but once?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Maybe...?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: And there's the rub! This is a hero's trial, mind you — there's no way I could let you breeze past it that easily.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: But that's fine. I'll let you try again for free!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: That way, you'll witness the final trial's true difficulty for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? No need for any Mora this time around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Seeing as it's free, let's give it another go...

choices.text: "Free"'s the highest price of them all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That doesn't make sense either, but anyway... let's give this one more try!

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: So then, your second try of the final trial. Shall we begin?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's do this.

response.speaker: Mamull
response.text: Hehe. Well then, do be careful this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! This try's free anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: How about it? Would you like to try the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to learn more about the rules again?

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: When are those two foreign guests going to realize that this whole thing is a scam...

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: *sigh*... It's happened so many times... *sigh* This hustler Mamull keeps using me to scam people...

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: But my child is locked up in there. If I could just stage a rescue...

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Be careful... This fellow's a cunning one... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Iktomisaur Chick
dialogues.text: Ohh... When can I get out of here...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Dammit, you bloody Iktomisaur, you... Don't you care about your own child anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Krraaa—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! We realized something was up, and we've already saved the little Iktomisaurus!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this trial's a scam...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: And here I thought that we had two fattened outlander sheep waltzing in, but no, you're just scoundrels, here to ruin everything!

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Krraaa—!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Alright, alright! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give our Mora back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it was 500 Mora each time... and you scammed Paimon so many times!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Alright, alright! Here, you two... take it. This... This should be enough, right?

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Krraaa—!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Uh... Mister... or Miss... Saurian...? L—Let's talk this through, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Look, I provided your child with a safe place, gave it food and water... Aren't you going to show even a little gratitude?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mouthing off at a time like this, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: N—No, pl—please!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Iktomisaurus flaps its wings, sending frigid air swirling around the scammer who had trapped its child.\nSoon, the swindler Mamull is forced to flee under the threat of razor-sharp Saurian claws...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After that, the Iktomisaurus bows in thanks before departing, youngling in tow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, this guy kept scamming Paimon for all that Mora, over and over again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Serves him right!

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Iktomisaurus
dialogues.text: Really... When was that? Huh, was it when those two foreigners approached a while back...?

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Mamull

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Ah, such excitement! Come then, traveler from afar, dear esteemed guest: Can you pass the test this time around? This way, please...!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Now then, as for the stones mentioned in the quiz before... What color were they?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Well, are you ready with Round 1's answers?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: My, how quick-witted you are, dear guest! This test is too easy, too basic for you.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: But as you can see, there's still a little bit to go before your final reward.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: How about it? Do you want to keep going? In any case... Hehe, it's 500 Mora to play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's keep going. We've got more than enough to cover the fee...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Thank you for your patronage, then!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. Now then, Round Two of the Painted Stone Challenge — a tougher challenge, to be sure. What will the result be? Would you like to begin?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Go on then, shall we try Round 2 of the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to hear about the rules again?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Oh-ho, there were more stones, I imagine? Now, what color were they?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Well then! Are your Round 2 answers ready?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: You had to memorize the color of the extra stone, but you guessed them all correctly without hesitation! You might be from a foreign land, but you really are an incredible hero.

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: And now, we've reached this stage at last... If you can answer this final question and clear the final stage— I mean, the final trial, and the reward will be yours!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: How about it? Would you like to keep going?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's 500 Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: And indeed it is. Thanks for your patronage!

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Round 3 of the Painted Stone Challenge, my foreign guest, is the final test, and a tremendously exciting one at that! Shall we begin now?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Go on then, shall we try Round 3 of the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to hear about the rules again?

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Haha! So, the final trial. Sometimes, the most dangerous moment comes precisely when you're closest to victory...

dialogues.speaker: Mamull
dialogues.text: Well, are you ready for the final round?
